1.t: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

2.t: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

4.t: Master of the Day of Judgment,

5.t: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

7.t: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
